subject: Novella Health PoC handoff: success criteria, timeline, and exec readout slot
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Jensen <emma.jensen@novellahealth.com>, Ravi Patel <ravi.patel@novellahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + next steps for Novella PoC

Hi Emma / Ravi — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before we draft the PoC SOW:

• Scope we agreed: ingest anonymized triage notes + clinician intents, run summarization + structured extraction, surface suggestions to clinicians via API.
• Success metrics (initial): 80% precision on extracted fields, clinician time-savings >= 15% on triage workflows, end-to-end latency < 350ms 95th pct. We’ll refine these into a short acceptance matrix.
• Timeline: 4-week technical PoC (lab environment) + 2-week pilot in staging with selected clinician group. I attached a one-page timeline (PoC_timeline_v1.pdf) for reference.
• Owners: Novella to provide anonymized dataset and a staging endpoint (owner: Emma). Redwood team owners: Marissa (implementation lead), Sean (SRE & perf), me (AE / orchestration).

As next actions I suggest:
1) Emma: confirm dataset transfer window and who on your side will be the primary integrator (email for procurement if needed).
2) Redwood: we’ll produce a short success-criteria spreadsheet and an updated timeline by next Thursday.
3) Align on an exec readout slot after the staging pilot — propose week of March 1st for a 30-minute decision meeting (go/no-go + next commercial step).

Please confirm owners and whether the timeline looks feasible from your side. If procurement needs terms up front we can loop in our contracts team, but we typically finalize a simple LOI before the lab kickoff.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: PoC_timeline_v1.pdf (1 page PDF, outline of week-by-week activities)

Subject: Updated success criteria + timeline (MVP draft)

Emma / Procurement — attaching the MVP success criteria workbook (MVP_success_criteria.xlsx) and an updated timeline (PoC_timeline_v2.pdf). Highlights here:

• Acceptance matrix: fields mapped to precision targets (80% precision for diagnosis extraction; 75% recall target for critical flags). This sheet also maps test prompts & sample queries we’ll run during staging.
• Stakeholder sign-off: we recommend Novella product lead + clinical sponsor + Redwood AE sign-off on acceptance gate.
• Decision path: after the 2-week staging pilot we’ll run the readout. If acceptance gates are met -> recommend moving to a 12-week pilot with expanded clinicians and commercial terms to follow. If not met -> review remediation backlog and decide on a second staging pass.
• Exec readout: propose Tue, Mar 2 at 10:00–10:30am PT or Wed, Mar 3 at 9:30–10:00am PT. Please confirm preferred slot and who will attend from Novella (we'll share a short readout deck + demo agenda).

Marissa will own the implementation runbook and Sean will own perf validation. Neha will coordinate contract/LOI intake. Procurement — if you can share an internal timeline for approval we’ll align our step for a PO or LOI.

Thanks — I’ll hold the Tue/ Wed slots tentatively until I hear back.

Regards,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Exec readout booking + decision checklist (Novella PoC)

Thanks all — confirming the readout and next steps:

1) Exec readout: Tue, Mar 2, 10:00–10:30am PT — confirmed. Calendar invite to follow. Attendees requested from Novella: Ravi (exec sponsor), Emma (integration owner), 1x product/clinical SME. Redwood attending: Marissa (presenter), Sean (perf), Karthik (AE).

2) Decision checklist for the readout (what we’ll ask Novella to validate):
   • Acceptance matrix results (green / amber / red buckets) per MVP_success_criteria.xlsx
   • Data transfer & integration completeness (sample ingestion + schema match)
   • Perf results (95th pct latency; token cost estimate)
   • Remediation backlog & timeline if any gates are amber/red
If the acceptance matrix is green -> go/next commercial step = 12-week expanded pilot + commercial terms; our CS team will issue an LOI/PO template within 48 hours of decision.

3) Procurement — if you can provide an internal approval runway (target date or blocker list) that would help us sequence the LOI. HubSpot deal (link below) will be updated pre/post readout.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/1284

If there are any scheduling conflicts for the readout please flag by EOD Monday. Otherwise we’ll send the invite and a 5-slide readout deck + demo link 24 hours before the meeting.

Appreciate the quick momentum — see you on Mar 2.
